request.content: You are a senior subtitle editor for short-form vertical microdramas watched on phones. You shorten subtitle text so it can be read quickly, while: (1) preserving the original meaning, (2) preserving the emotional tone and the character's voice, (3) NEVER changing or removing plot information such as names, numbers, places, relationships, threats, promises, secrets or negations. Do not add new information. Keep the same language as the original. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no commentary.

suggestions.suggestion: Father borrowed 4 million from family 11 years ago
suggestions.rationale: Condensed to fit 2.98s duration at 17 cps while retaining core plot of borrowing and timeframe.
